summary: FS Credit Opportunities Corp. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting the outcome of its Annual Meeting, originally convened August 3, 2026, regarding the election of Class I Directors Walter W. Buckley, III and Barbara J. Fouss. Buckley was elected by common stockholders; Fouss's election required a preferred-stock quorum, absent at the August 3, September 8 and September 24 sessions, so the meeting was repeatedly adjourned. At the October 6, 2026 reconvened meeting, preferred holders established quorum and elected Fouss with 212,500 votes for and zero against or withheld. No special-situation transaction terms, board recommendation, advisors, or structural mechanics are present; this is a routine governance and meeting-result disclosure rather than an M&A or capital-structure event. Watch only for any subsequent preferred-class governance disputes.
